diagnosis: Four measured PUTs exhausted their 10-second client budgets after leader termination while survivor terms rose to 11. The replacement PUT was never confirmed and does not appear in any retained log/session. The probe incorrectly wrapped that failure in retryable IOException, obscuring the original timeout until its subsequent GET returned null. The run remained invalid. This is an observed availability-budget failure, not evidence that an acknowledged replacement was deleted.
probe_fix: Only the explicitly injected discarded-reply exception is retryable; failed control/probe operations now propagate terminal exceptions with the original response.
remaining_limit: No protocol or timer change was made. Election churn and request-budget exhaustion can recur under this local workload; a same-seed rerun does not establish a liveness fix.
